struct State { unsigned char pad[2]; int handle; }; extern struct State far state; extern int far handle; extern int far otherHandle; extern int near choose; extern int far * far GetHandle(void); extern void far consume(int);
{{FORM}}

FORM.direct_global: void far f(void) { if (handle != 0) { consume(handle); handle = 0; } }
FORM.local_pointer_address: void far f(void) { int far *p; p = &handle; if (*p != 0) { consume(*p); *p = 0; } }
FORM.local_pointer_member: void far f(void) { int far *p; p = &state.handle; if (*p != 0) { consume(*p); *p = 0; } }
FORM.pointer_field_address: void far f(void) { struct { int far *p; } h; h.p = &handle; if (*h.p != 0) { consume(*h.p); *h.p = 0; } }
FORM.pointer_field_member: void far f(void) { struct { int far *p; } h; h.p = &state.handle; if (*h.p != 0) { consume(*h.p); *h.p = 0; } }
FORM.pointer_returned: void far f(void) { int far *p; p = GetHandle(); if (*p != 0) { consume(*p); *p = 0; } }
FORM.address_plus_one: void far f(void) { int far *p; p = &state.handle; if (*p != 0) { consume(*p); *p = 0; } }
FORM.conditional_address: void far f(void) { int far *p; p = (choose != 0) ? &handle : &otherHandle; if (*p != 0) { consume(*p); *p = 0; } }
